panel_parity_contract: Only synthetic explicitly timed CTMC panel paths and matching joint nominal token channels are compared. No source label is converted to elapsed time; no first-entry-density, annual-engine, clinical state or general nominal embeddability equivalence is asserted.

scope.density_outputs: Exact-first-entry density has reciprocal-year units and may exceed one.
scope.diagnostics: Expose initial sum-minus-one and each generator scaled row sum, alongside existing exponential roundoff-correction and normalizer diagnostics.
scope.finite_density_representation: Reject nonfinite aggregate hazards into an exact-event group, nonfinite exact-event factor, nonfinite log likelihood for a nonzero path, and nonfinite displayed likelihood. Finite reciprocal-year densities may still exceed one. Structural zero remains log=-infinity; positive ordinary-probability underflow retains finite log likelihood. No repair, clamp or empirical cap.
scope.generator_conservation: Nonnegative off-diagonals and nonpositive diagonal; each full row scaled by its largest absolute hazard before zero-sum check, using the bounded dimensionless caller allowance. Zero rows have zero deviation. No rates repaired.
scope.initial_and_categorical_mass: Each entry in [0,1]; row/unit-simplex deviation within caller allowance; no input row repair.
scope.initial_forward_scaling: Accepted nonunit initial mass retained explicitly in log likelihood and normalizers, including zero-time terminals. Working forward normalization is likelihood-preserving, not input repair.
scope.numerical_failures: A mathematically valid all-state observation can fail because exponential or forward arithmetic yields slight surplus mass. Fail explicitly; do not convert a numerical error into structural impossibility.
scope.probability_outputs: Reject non-density contribution with log likelihood >0 or displayed probability >1. Reject exponential entries or interval-event conditional probability >1. No positive mass clamp or silent normalization.
scope.rank_tolerance: Separate relative singular-value design choice remains in (0,1); stochastic ceiling does not apply.

stochastic_roundoff_ceiling.basis: Existing registered longitudinal_probability_absolute_tolerance; a software ceiling, not clinical uncertainty or empirical acceptance.
